areas.title: Main dashboard layout with navigation
areas.notes: DashboardLayout (src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx): Full-viewport bg-muted/30, header with bg-card border-b, Mail icon + 'Prunebox' logo (text-primary), DashboardNav responsive (desktop: hidden md:flex with gap-4, mobile: hamburger menu with overlay). User avatar (h-8 w-8) with fallback, ghost variant Sign Out button. Main container with mx-auto px-4 py-6. Auth protection via redirect to /auth/signin. Design tokens: primary emerald, proper border, card surfaces.

areas.title: Subscription list display with sender names and email counts
areas.notes: SubscriptionList (src/components/subscriptions/subscription-list.tsx): Search input with Search icon (absolute left-3), filter buttons (All, High/Low Confidence, Has Unsubscribe), sort Select with ArrowUpDown icon. Subscription cards: Checkbox, expandable Chevron, senderName (font-semibold), senderEmail (text-muted-foreground), badges (email count, confidence %, can unsubscribe). Empty state with Mail icon. Resizable list (drag handle with GripHorizontal), pagination (Load More button). Mobile responsive: h-12 px-4 buttons, collapsible filters. Design tokens verified.

areas.title: Scan button with progress indicator during email scanning
areas.notes: ScanButton (src/components/dashboard/scan-button.tsx): Primary button with Scan icon (idle) or RefreshCw animate-spin (scanning). Progress display: 'Scanning {scanProgress}/{scanTotal}'. Rate limit countdown with 'Retry in {s}s'. DropdownMenu with Quick/Complete Scan options, Reset & Clear All (destructive with Trash2 icon). Polling every 2s via /api/scan/status. Toast notifications for completion/failure (destructive variant on error). Rounded-l-none/r-none styling for button group. Design tokens: primary, destructive proper.

areas.title: Subscription action buttons (keep, unsubscribe, rollup)
areas.notes: Action buttons in SubscriptionList: Desktop (hidden sm:flex gap-2): Delete (destructive, Trash icon), Rollup (secondary/outline toggle, Layers icon), Unsubscribe (secondary/outline toggle, MailX icon). Mobile (sm:hidden): MoreVertical dropdown with same actions. Bulk actions: Delete All (destructive, Trash icon), Unsubscribe (outline, Trash2 icon). Button sizes: h-8 px-3 for card actions, h-12 px-4 for mobile. Disabled state during processing (processingSenderEmails). Design tokens: destructive red, proper icon sizing.

areas.title: Rollup digest configuration dialog
areas.notes: ConfigureRollupDialog (src/components/dashboard/configure-rollup-dialog.tsx): Dialog with Settings2 icon trigger (outline variant), DialogContent sm:max-w-[425px]. Form controls: Enable Rollup Switch, Digest Name Input placeholder 'My Daily Rollup', Delivery Time RadioGroup (3 slots: Morning 8:00, Afternoon 2:00, Evening 8:00 PM), Timezone Select (13 common zones). Loading state: Loader2 spinner centered py-8 with 'Loading...' on save button. Error display: bg-destructive/10 p-3 rounded-md. Design tokens verified: primary emerald 160 84% 32%, destructive 0 84.2% 60.2%, proper Label/Switch spacing. Code verification complete.

areas.title: Settings page with account and preferences
areas.notes: Settings page (src/app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx): Layout max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6, header with text-3xl font-bold heading + text-muted-foreground description, ThemeToggle top-right. Responsive grid md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 for sidebar + content. Sidebar navigation with ghost variant Buttons (User, Bell, Shield icons), active state text-primary bg-primary/10. Account tab: Profile Card with disabled Inputs (name/email from session), Gmail Access Card with text-destructive title + bg-destructive/10 warning box. Notifications: Coming soon placeholder. Privacy tab: Google API disclosure (bg-primary/5 border-primary/20), Data Export (Download icon + Loader2 spinner), Delete Account (destructive AlertDialog with Trash2). Design tokens verified: primary emerald 160 84% 32%, destructive 0 84.2% 60.2%, proper spacing and card surfaces. Code verification complete.

areas.title: Google OAuth sign-in flow
areas.notes: Sign-in page with centered Card layout (bg-card, max-w-md, p-8, rounded-xl shadow-lg), Mail icon in primary color circle (bg-primary/10 h-16 w-16), 'Welcome to Prunebox' heading (text-2xl font-bold), subtitle (text-muted-foreground), 'Continue with Google' button with official Google logo (svg, w-5 h-5), ThemeToggle in top-right, legal footer with Privacy/Terms links (underline hover:text-foreground), Google API Limited Use disclosure (bg-primary/5 border-primary/20). Error handling via URL error param with toast notifications (destructive variant). Design tokens verified: primary emerald 160 84% 32%, bg-card, text-muted-foreground, proper spacing. areas.title: Dark/light theme toggle
areas.notes: ThemeToggle component (src/components/theme-toggle.tsx) verified on landing and sign-in pages. Uses next-themes with class-based toggling (attribute='class', defaultTheme='dark', enableSystem). Light mode CSS vars: primary 160 84% 32% (#1F7D53 emerald), background 0 0% 100% (white), foreground 100 50% 10%. Dark mode CSS vars: primary 160 84% 39% (brighter emerald), background 220 14% 6% (dark blue), card 220 14% 10%. Icon animation: Sun (rotate-0 scale-100) transitions to Moon (rotate-90 scale-0), with smooth rotate/scale transitions. Theme persists to localStorage. Button styling: ghost variant, h-9 w-9 p-0, sr-only label. Verified via browser evaluation at http://localhost:3001.

areas.title: Landing page with product description
areas.notes: Landing page (src/app/page.tsx): Gradient background (from-background via-background to-muted), header (bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-b) with logo (Mail icon h-6 w-6 text-primary + 'Prunebox' text-xl font-bold), nav (Self-Host ghost, Sign In, ThemeToggle). Hero: privacy badge (Shield bg-primary/10 rounded-full), gradient headline 'Take Back Control...' (bg-clip-text text-transparent from-primary to-foreground, text-5xl md:text-6xl font-bold), subtitle (text-xl text-muted-foreground), CTA buttons (Get Started Free with Zap, Self-Host outline). Feature cards: responsive grid (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3), each bg-card p-8 rounded-xl shadow-sm border, icon squares (Bulk Deletion: Trash2 bg-destructive/10, Smart Grouping: Mail bg-primary/10, True Unsubscribe: Shield bg-muted). Comparison section: 'Better than Unroll.me' (bg-muted/30 border). Footer (border-t bg-background/80, text-sm text-muted-foreground). Design tokens verified: primary emerald rgb(16,183,127), card rgb(22,24,29), Inter font. Screenshot: .lazydave/test-logs/screenshots/T9-landing-page.png

areas.name: Rollup digest email content and format
areas.notes: runRollup job (src/modules/queues/jobs.ts:588-663): Generates plain text digest email. Subject: 'Your Prunebox Subscription Digest ({n} subscriptions)'. Body format: Header with count, numbered list (1. Sender Name (email) + Unsubscribe URL/mailto if available), footer with '---' separator and management link (https://prunebox.app/dashboard). Subscriptions sorted alphabetically by senderName. Sent via sendEmail() to user's Gmail using stored access_token. Rollup page displays subscriptions in Card with avatar circles (h-10 w-10 bg-primary/10), empty state with Mail icon, Delivery schedule Card (Clock/Calendar icons), Quick actions (Send Test Digest, Disable Rollup destructive). Code verification complete.

areas.name: Subscription list item states (hover, loading, error, empty)
areas.notes: List item states verified: Hover (hover:bg-accent/50 transition-all), Selected (ring-2 ring-primary). areas.name: Settings page sections and navigation
areas.notes: Settings navigation (src/app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx): Sidebar with 3 tabs - Account (User icon), Notifications (Bell icon), Privacy (Shield icon). Active tab styling: text-primary bg-primary/10 font-medium, inactive: text-muted-foreground. Full-width ghost variant Buttons with justify-start and icon (mr-2 h-4 w-4). Tab content area: md:grid-cols-3 space-y-6. Account section: Profile Information Card (2-column grid for name/email, disabled Inputs), Gmail Access Card (destructive title with warning box). Notifications section: Single Card with 'Coming soon' placeholder. Privacy section: Card with Google API Limited Use disclosure, Separator, Data Collection row with Download button, Delete Account row with destructive AlertDialog. Responsive: flex-col on mobile, grid on desktop. Code verification complete.

areas.name: OAuth callback page with success/error states
areas.notes: Callback page at /auth/callback/page.tsx returns null (intentional) - NextAuth handles actual OAuth callback at /api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts. Success state: Redirects to /dashboard after successful authentication. Error states: Redirects to /auth/signin with error parameter (OAuthAccountNotLinked, OAuthCallbackError, AccessDenied, Configuration), triggers toast notification with specific error messages. No visual callback page needed - handled by NextAuth session management. Design verified: Error toasts use destructive variant with proper title/description. Auth config includes signIn callback preventing account linking between different Google accounts.

areas.name: Auth error page displays OAuth error messages
areas.notes: Error messages handled via URL error param on sign-in page (/auth/signin). useEffect hook detects error parameter and triggers toast notification (destructive variant). Specific error messages for: OAuthAccountNotLinked ('Account Not Linked'), OAuthCallbackError ('Authentication Failed'), AccessDenied ('Access Denied'), Configuration ('Configuration Error'), Default ('Authentication Error'). Error parameter cleared from URL after toast display using window.history.replaceState. Code verified in src/app/auth/signin/page.tsx lines 17-57. Design tokens: destructive variant toast, proper title/description structure.
